title: False positive CC sentinel rate: 26.6% of transcript entries
body: FX-003 scanned 1,190 Claude Code session JSONLs. Of these, 148 were false positives (26.6%) — context-continuation injections where the harness auto-inserts prior session context, making assistant text appear as a 'correction' when it is actually an injected continuation. 10/10 spot-check confirmed stripped entries were CC injections. 408 genuine corrections were preserved.
